newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Amex says $88 mln mutual fund oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Amex says $88 mln mutual fund oversubscribed.

text.p: American Express Bank in Egypt said on Friday its 300 million pound ($88 million) mutual fund ended more than three times oversubscribed after applicants asked to buy units for more than 900 million pounds.
The bank said in a published advertisement it would distribute the units to investors by April 14, or within two weeks after the fund closed on April 1.

The bank had increased the value of the fund to 300 million from the the 100 million it had initially offered. The income and capital growth fund will invest in local and international equities and bonds, American Express said.
It will pay income at six-monthly intervals, in April and in October and is managed by Hermes Fund Management. Units are worth 100 pounds each and investors had applied for at least five units.
American Express would put 15 million pounds of its own money in the mutual fund, or five percent of the total value according to regulations of the Capital Market Authority, another banker said.
